lines.beaver_en: Minji, you look pale. Are you okay?
lines.en: Since morning, I've felt achy, heavy, and sluggish.

lines.beaver_en: Where exactly do you feel unwell?
lines.learner: 비염 때문에 코가 막혀서 숨쉬기가 힘들어요.
lines.en: My nose is blocked from rhinitis, so it's hard to breathe.
lines.roman: Biyeom ttaemune koga makyeoseo sumswigiga himdeureoyo.

lines.beaver: 숨이 가쁘면 그냥 넘기면 안 돼요.
lines.beaver_en: You shouldn't ignore shortness of breath.
lines.beaver_roman: Sumi gappeumyeon geunyang neomgimyeon an dwaeyo.
lines.learner: 목에도 염증이 있어서 침도 못 삼킬 지경이에요.
lines.en: My throat is inflamed too. I can barely swallow.
lines.roman: Mogedo yeomjeungi isseoseo chimdo mot samkil jigyeongieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then why did you come in? Go to the hospital.
lines.learner: 오늘 마감이라 쉴 수가 없어서 난감해요.
lines.en: Today's the deadline, so I can't rest. It's tough.
lines.roman: Oneul magamira swil suga eopseoseo nangamhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: You keep rubbing your shoulders too. What's wrong?
lines.learner: 목이랑 어깨가 경직돼서 고개도 못 돌려요.
lines.en: My neck and shoulders are so stiff I can't turn my head.
lines.roman: Mogirang eokkaega gyeongjikdwaeseo gogaedo mot dollyeoyo.

lines.en: The doctor said it's text neck syndrome.

lines.beaver_en: Pushing yourself like that could end badly.
lines.learner: 머리가 멍해서 아무 생각이 안 나요.
lines.en: My head is so foggy I can't think at all.
lines.roman: Meoriga meonghaeseo amu saenggagi an nayo.

lines.en: Actually, I almost fainted on the stairs earlier.

lines.beaver_en: Really? What if your condition gets worse?
lines.learner: 이러다 중병이 될까 봐 저도 걱정돼요.
lines.en: I'm worried too that it could become serious.
lines.roman: Ireoda jungbyeongi doelkka bwa jeodo geokjeongdwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'll help with the work. Go home today.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 병세가 심해지기 전에 병원 갈게요.
lines.en: Thanks. I'll see a doctor before it gets worse.
lines.roman: Gomawoyo. Byeongsega simhaejigi jeone byeongwon galgeyo.
